one_line: A collaborative 3D home designer for people and browser agents.
what_it_does: Lets humans configure floors, rooms, walls, openings, and furnishings while an agent edits the same live design through structured tools and shared constraints.
leverage_rationale: The live shared spatial state, batch edits, alternatives, and identical constraint engine make an agent materially more reliable than pixel-driving a 3D editor, though a capable general agent could still operate the UI.
leverage_evidence: Pitch claims 21 live WebMCP tools and a shared rulebook.
Frame sheets show a persistent 3D editor with setup wizard, room shell, furnished model, and side panels.
execution_rationale: The packet coherently shows a substantial home-design workflow from floor selection through furnished 3D inspection, but no submitted video or end-to-end agent trace is available.
execution_evidence: Frames visibly progress from choosing floors and layouts to a consistent furnished multi-room 3D model.
Devpost packaging shows the 3D product preview and coherent claim set.
impact_rationale: Home and interior planning is a real spatial task where shared visual state and constraint feedback can save substantial effort for homeowners and designers.
impact_evidence: Description identifies wall, walkway, egress, aisle, and clearance constraints.
Frames show recognizable rooms and furnishings being inspected from multiple views.
creativity_rationale: The agent-in-the-room collaboration model and ghosted alternative layouts are a fresh, ambitious use of WebMCP for spatial design.
creativity_evidence: Human and agent edit the same live spatial object rather than exchanging a generated artifact.
Claimed proposal of multiple alternative layouts and shared legality rules.
usability_note: The visible editor has a clear staged setup and recognizable 3D inspection flow, though dense panels may require learning.
red_flags: No submitted video or direct agent invocation evidence; execution claims are not independently demonstrated.
standouts: Concrete 3D workflow visible in frame sheets.
advance_reason: High-quality, distinctive shared-state WebMCP concept with substantial visible product evidence.

leverage_rationale: Typed tools expose operational warehouse state, safety validation, approval gating, routing, and recovery as a shared contract; generic UI automation would be substantially less safe and reliable.
leverage_evidence: Description claims seven tools and a deterministic shared state engine.
Claims approval gate, route safety, heartbeat, reservations, safe stop, and replanning.
Frame sheets visibly show an operational command-center interface and mission/status views.
execution_rationale: The packet is unusually coherent about a full mission lifecycle and visible command-center states, though the absent video limits observed end-to-end proof.
execution_evidence: Claims a 7/7 ordered flow with completed mission and final metrics.
Frames show consistent warehouse dashboard, mission trace, and status-oriented UI.
impact_rationale: Safe, auditable agent control of warehouse vehicles addresses a high-consequence operational need with clear value for warehouse operators.
impact_evidence: Specific pallet, aisle blockage, AGV, routes, approval, and recovery scenario are described.
Safety engine checks destination, occupancy, battery, communication, and traffic reservations.
creativity_rationale: Combining WebMCP with a safety-gated physical-AI digital twin and explicit recovery workflow is ambitious and memorable.

Human approval is structurally required before physical movement.
usability_note: The operational stages and trace-oriented presentation appear legible and actionable.
red_flags: No submitted video; live claims are packaging/description evidence rather than observed execution.
advance_reason: Exceptional leverage and impact with a concrete, safety-conscious workflow.

usability_note: Approval checkpoints and explicit previews support understandable user control.

execution_evidence: Three frame sheets show consistent mailbox and message UI states.

creativity_evidence: Seller AI and buyer agent exchange offers over a bounded protocol.

usability_note: The familiar store and checkout flow contain the unusual negotiation interaction, with a human-visible widget.
red_flags: Live checkout and Shopify integration are claims rather than independently observed video evidence.
standouts: Most distinctive WebMCP-native commerce interaction in the packet.
advance_reason: Transformative leverage and exceptional creativity with a concrete transaction loop.

one_line: A local-first communication rehearsal workspace that audits partner adaptation, not the person.
what_it_does: Lets a person author a communication protocol, rehearse human-only or agent-assisted turns, enforce signals and stop rules, and produce adherence evidence without evaluating the person.
leverage_rationale: The agent must operate under person-authored permissions, deterministic protocol checks, revision freshness, idempotency, and terminal safety signals; structured tools materially change what safe collaboration can be.
leverage_evidence: Transcript describes agent access disabled by default, exposed-field scoping, rejected invalid turns, stale-write rejection, and terminal Stop.
Video frame sheets show onboarding/protocol editor, rehearsal, guardrail failure, and audit states.
execution_rationale: The 156-second video transcript and frames provide unusually strong end-to-end evidence of protocol authoring, invalid/repaired turns, signal handling, revision conflict, stop, and partner-only audit.
execution_evidence: Transcript explicitly walks through rejected long turns, repaired turn, amber signal, stale revision recovery, and terminal red stop.
Frames show a coherent local-first workspace across setup, rehearsal, and reporting.
impact_rationale: Adults with speech, language, or processing needs and their communication partners have a specific underserved need; shifting evaluation toward partner adaptation is directly valuable and respectful.
impact_evidence: Description identifies protocol authorship, pace, literal language, signals, and partner actions.
Audit explicitly excludes comprehension, capacity, emotion, diagnosis, consistency, and consent scoring.
creativity_rationale: The ethical inversion of communication support—auditing whether the partner adapted rather than whether the person performed—is genuinely novel and deeply pursued.
creativity_evidence: Person-authored protocol with semantic signals and silence-as-no-event.
Agent can stage provenance-linked drafts but cannot ratify, publish, or override owner decisions.
usability_note: The visible protocol and rehearsal structure is deliberate and protective, though the domain inherently has a learning burden.
red_flags: Open-alpha scope may limit breadth, but this is not a quality defect for the demonstrated target.
standouts: Strong end-to-end video evidence and meaningful safety boundaries.
advance_reason: Outstanding impact, creativity, leverage, and unusually well-evidenced execution.
